newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL tin closes two cents up at 14.54 rgt/kg.
newsitem.headline: KL tin closes two cents up at 14.54 rgt/kg.

text.p: Malaysia's tin price rose two cents to 14.54 ringgit ($5.86) a kg, despite Friday's fall on the London Metal Exchange (LME), traders said.
"There was some good buying, particularly from Europe, and that's why the local market ignored the LME," said a trader.
Traders noted initial bids for 138 tonnes against offers of 119. Final turnover was 118 tonnes, against 114 on Monday, and was absorbed by European, Japanese and local interests.
Traders said the local price was at a discount of $20 against the LME, compared to $30 previously.
